scope: Independent read-only review of exactly frozen transport Cargo +4 Rust sources; no Cargo/rustc/fmt/tests/QEMU/USB/network execution by reviewer. Root owns actual build/run results.

checks.finding: Both builders choose ring explicitly and with_protocol_versions TLS13 only.
WebPkiClientVerifier default requires client authentication; no allow_unauthenticated or dangerous verifier.
Client uses explicit roots and validated ServerName, retaining normal chain/time/usage/name verification.
Only completed accepted TLS produces a policy-mapped leaf DER SHA256 peer; a configured pin cannot bypass PKI.
Both sides require negotiated TLS1.3 and exact ALPN after handshake; fixes missing-ALPN default behavior.
NoServerSessionStorage, tickets0, early_data0, half_rtt=false and default NeverProducesTickets retained behind private config.
Resumption disabled, early data false and immutable private connector.
4-chain/32-root/16KiB each/64KiB total and 16KiB key, duplicates and mismatch rejected; caller owns secure file loading.
64 principals,2 pins,16 devices; duplicate IDs/shared pins/duplicate devices rejected; empty policy denies.
Backend-qualified physical/native fingerprints; fixed virtual enums cannot authorize physical devices.
VerifiedPeer fields private; verified_peer crate-private; external caller cannot invent principal string.
Arc-backed startup policy; replacement policy intentionally does not revoke existing authenticated streams.
Allows uses exact typed allowlist membership; USB DEVLIST/IMPORT integration is explicitly future work.
try_acquire_owned rejects overload before creating the handshake future; server clones share Arc Semaphore.
Private inner and permit owned by stream; no into_inner/get_mut/Deref escape; fields drop inner before permit.
Timeout/error/cancel drops local handshake stream and acquired permit through ownership.
Production5s deadline, per-connection TLS buffer64KiB; not claimed as whole-process RSS limit.
No certificate/key/raw IO Debug exposure or raw errors interpolated into public setup failures.
AsyncWrite forwards flush/shutdown; callers must write_all+flush in same application deadline. No engine integration claimed.
Crate does not open sockets/listeners, credential paths or USB devices and does not introduce helper RPC.
Authored positive test performs real mTLS over bounded DuplexStream, validates pin/principal/ACL and24KiB+reply with explicit flush/backpressure.
Authored wrong-name, unknown-CA, pinned-untrusted-CA, missing-client-cert, expiry and wrong-EKU tests preserve standard verification.
Authored removed/unmapped pin and missing/wrong ALPN tests, including client success not being device authorization.
Authored repeated full handshake assertions and explicit disabled-storage/ticket/early-data/compression checks.
Authored16streams/clone/overload/drop, deterministic one-poll cancellation, and shortened test-only timeout checks.
Authored exact namespaces/hex/bounds/ambiguous policy/DER/key/name/Debug regressions.
Production source has no unsafe block, unwrap(), expect(), panic(), insecure verifier or raw inner escape.
Only foundation module; neither memory TLS tests nor this source review prove encrypted USB/IP, TCP, PCAP or physical hardware.

resolved_review_finding: Configured ALPN list alone permits missing ALPN for regular TLS in fixed rustls; candidate now checks negotiated ALPN and version on both sides, with authored missing/wrong-ALPN negative test.
limitations: Tests are reviewed source only, not executed by this reviewer.
16 applies to one server/its clones; caller must bound accepted tasks/connections before invoking library.
The private verified peer is an authenticated policy context, not a hardware identity or lease; future integration must retain connection association.
Startup pin removal is tested for new handshakes; no active-session revocation/credential-file privilege or root RPC is implemented here.
USB DEVLIST/IMPORT/long-URB integration and encrypted network acceptance remain unimplemented; no Phase3 completion.
